buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 2. Forms of EMD and PBG

Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of ZONAL ACCOUNTS OFFICER, CBDT payable at GUWAHATI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of ZONAL ACCOUNTS OFFICERS, CBDT payable at GUWAHATI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 4. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Local Office Proof & Operations Requirement Local Operational Presence: The bidder must have a functional, registered regional office located within Gu wahati, Kamrup Metro District to ensure immediate resolution of operational, labour management and ad ministrative issues. Proof required: Valid Trade License & Establishment Registration Certificate / GST Registration in the name of the bidding entity reflecting the local office address. Self-declarations will not be accepted. 2. Local Labour Laws & Welfare Compliance Compliance with Local Labour Regulations: The service provider must be registered under the local state l abour authorities Labour Commissionerate, Assam and ensure full compliance with the minimum wage rat es notified by the Central Government, EPF, ESIC, and local welfare regulations. Proof required: Valid EPF Code, ESIC Code and State Labour License. 3. Verification of Credentials Documentary Proof Submission: Bidders must upload valid documentary proof of their local presence alon g with technical bid submissions. Bids submitted without verifiable local office proof during the technical e valuation stage will be treated as non-responsive and rejected.

4. Timely Payment of Wages to Contractual Employees The service provider shall ensure that the wages/salaries of all contractual employees deployed under the contract are paid regularly and within the applicable statutory timelines, without any unauthorised deducti on or withholding. The service provider shall submit documentary proof of wage payment, such as bank transfer statements, wage registers, payslips and other relevant records, along with the prescribed monthly compliance docum ents, as required by the competent authority. Any complaint regarding non-payment or delay in payment of wages by more than 12 (twelve) calendar d ays beyond the applicable due date shall be examined by the competent authority. Where the complaint is substantiated, the service provider shall be issued a notice to explain the delay and shall be required to rel ease the outstanding wages immediately, subject to applicable law. Failure to rectify the default within the period specified in the notice, repeated delays in wage payment, or established non-payment of wages shall attract appropriate action under the contract and applicable GeM terms and conditions, including levy of permissible penalties, recovery of dues, termination of the contract or other contractual remedies, as applicable, after following the prescribed procedure. 5. Financial Capacity to Meet Salary and Operational Expenditure The bidder shall demonstrate adequate financial capacity and liquidity to meet salary/wage payments, stat utory contributions and other essential operational expenses for at least 6 (six) consecutive months, witho ut depending solely on the release of monthly bills by the Department. For this purpose, the bidder shall furnish appropriate documentary evidence, which may include: a. Audited financial statements for the prescribed preceding financial years; b. A certificate from a Chartered Accountant indicating the bidder's working capital and financial position; a nd/or The required financial threshold shall be proportionate to the estimated value and nature of the contract a nd shall be specified in the bid documents. The same objective criteria shall apply uniformly to all bidders. Non-submission of mandatory financial documents or failure to meet the published financial eligibility crite ria shall render the bid liable for rejection in accordance with the applicable GeM procurement procedure. . 6. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED.
